items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: there were other clubs too, like the Cotton Club, where Les Hite's band was playing.

ctx.x: Yes, uh-huh. I didn't realize that was her sister.

Well, that was her sister. And, well, Lillian and I became very dear friends when I first came here, and they -- she and Paul Howard's wife, who was Sue Hoye (PHONETIC), and oh, so many of the guys, so many of the people that I met at that time, they were all working on Central Avenue. And of course at that time, there also -- there were other clubs too, like the Cotton Club, where Les Hite's band was playing. And then --
